name: Survey tile in Cancer
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 3.4 degrees south of the ecliptic in Cancer, imaged by SPHEREx 10 times in 4 visits over 33 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 20 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 33 hours starting 2025-10-30, at wavelengths from 1.64 to 4.97 µm. The pipeline found 2 moving objects.
